truths.truth: A cache fact cannot carry one run's traffic onto a bracket from a different run
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/lib/subagent-trace.mjs `closedBracket()` (:250-253) searches the WHOLE record - `rows.find((row) => row && row.agent_id === id)` with no corr term - and gate 2a then quotes that bracket's `corr` and `phase` onto the fact (`withheld()` at :362, `closed || mine[0]`). The fold's corr scope therefore cannot absorb a cross-run id collision, because the fact's corr was copied FROM the colliding bracket. Observed in this pass: a trace holding an OLDRUN/phase-1 cad-verifier bracket closed under agent_id W1, plus a live RUN1/phase-3 dispatch, given a stop payload with agent_id W1 -> the hook appended `{"corr":"OLDRUN","phase":1,...,"event":"worker_cache","agent_id":"W1","cache_creation_input_tokens":777,"cache_read_input_tokens":88888}` and the render put those figures on the 17-day-old phase-1 bracket while the current RUN1 dispatch stayed unpaired with no figures. Pre-change the same unscoped match was a silent no-op; this phase turned it into a write.

gaps.name: A cache fact can land on a bracket from a different run when the host reuses an agent_id
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - gate 2a's `closedBracket()` matches agent_id across the WHOLE record with no corr term, and the fact then quotes that bracket's corr and phase, so the fold's corr scope has nothing left to protect
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/bin/lib/subagent-trace.mjs:250-253 (`rows.find((row) => row && row.agent_id === id)`) and :362 (`closed || mine[0]`). Reproduced: an OLDRUN/phase-1 cad-verifier bracket closed under W1 plus a live RUN1/phase-3 dispatch, stop payload agent_id W1 -> hook wrote `corr: OLDRUN, phase: 1` and the render put 777/88,888 on the phase-1 bracket while the RUN1 dispatch stayed unpaired and figureless. CONTEXT.md's flagged assumption states the opposite - that D-10's corr scope absorbs a cross-session collision - and CONTEXT.md D-10 measured 7 of 1,323 distinct ids repeating within one project. A phase-filtered render never sees the mis-placed figure.
gaps.missing: Either scope `closedBracket` to the run the candidate set names (or to the phase in the payload's reach) so gate 2a cannot import a foreign corr, or correct CONTEXT.md's flagged assumption to say a cross-run collision is NOT absorbed. Pre-change this same unscoped match was a silent no-op, so the write is new surface this phase added.
